direction_rules: Pure Semantic Kernel (Rule #6): src/ckodex_aiops/kernel imports no adapters, no transport, and zero framework SDKs (Ray, Torch, Lance, Kedro, Vault, OTel).
Shared Validation (Rule #8): src/ckodex_aiops/validation imports only from kernel and pure schemas; it is never imported by kernel and imports no adapters.
Transport & Adapters (Rule #9): src/ckodex_aiops/adapters depend inward on kernel and validation, translating domain contracts to concrete runtimes without leaking runtime specifics.

flows.name: Intent Admission to Lineage Receipt Lifecycle
flows.trigger: Principal or caller submits execution intent via CLI or API

hops.intent: run() receives pipeline execution intent and initializes runtime context
AuthorityPath defines standing hierarchy: tenant, workspace, environment, project
CapabilityLease issues time-bounded, attenuated permissions with expiry timestamp
IntentEnvelope wraps caller identity, requested capability, lease, and PROPOSED state
AuthorityValidator verifies tenant/workspace validity and unrevoked lease status
IntentEnvelope.transition() advances envelope lifecycle to ADMITTED
compute_sha256() computes cryptographic hashes of inputs and runtime parameters
LineageReceipt records immutable execution facts, input/output digests, and authority URN

hidden: CapabilityLease automatically expires when epoch exceeds expires_at_epoch (src/ckodex_aiops/kernel/intent.py:58)
AuthorityValidator immediately emits DENY disposition if lease.revoked is True (src/ckodex_aiops/validation/validators.py:34)

flows.name: Model Training & Content-Addressed SLSA Attestation
flows.trigger: Execution of ckodex-aiops run --pipeline=training or kedro run --pipeline=training

hops.intent: CLI triggers Kedro session for model_training pipeline
train_representation_model() splits Lance feature vectors into train/val datasets
VectorRepresentationNet instantiates PyTorch feedforward network with residual GELU projections
ModelTrainer.fit() runs training epochs with AdamW optimization and validation metrics
ModelTrainer.save_checkpoint() serializes memory-safe model.safetensors and returns SHA-256 digest
hash_file() computes content-addressed digest of checkpoint on disk
IntotoProvenanceAttestor.generate_attestation() mints in-toto SLSA v1.0 statement

hidden: ModelTrainer dual-saves legacy .pt format alongside zero-copy .safetensors (src/ckodex_aiops/pipelines/model_training/nodes.py:68)
Attestor raises FileNotFoundError before side effects if subject artifact is absent (src/ckodex_aiops/adapters/compliance/intoto.py:34)

flows.name: Autonomic Day-2 Drift Detection & Reconciliation Loop
flows.trigger: Scheduled cron or manual execution of ckodex-aiops reconcile

hops.intent: reconcile() instantiates AutonomicReconciler against target baseline profile
AutonomicReconciler.observe() probes Lance dataset fragments, model weights, and runtime health
AutonomicReconciler.detect() detects drift anomalies including FRAGMENT_BLOAT and MISSING_CHECKPOINT
AutonomicReconciler.diagnose() computes 7-dimension StateVector with valence and coherence
StateVector.is_healthy() evaluates anti-dominance invariant where contradictions dominate scores
ReconciliationReceipt computes cryptographic evidence digest of the reconciliation cycle

hidden: FRAGMENT_BLOAT (>3 fragment files) automatically triggers dataset compaction (src/ckodex_aiops/kernel/reconciler.py:117)
MISSING_CHECKPOINT anomaly marks auto_healable=False, halting automated recovery for human intervention (src/ckodex_aiops/kernel/reconciler.py:137)

flows.name: OCI Image Layout Packaging & Integrity Verification
flows.trigger: Execution of ckodex-aiops oci pack --version 1.0.0 --tag latest

hops.intent: oci_pack() invokes OciTemplatePackager.pack_oci_layout with target version and tag
create_template_archive() builds hermetic .tar.gz archive excluding caches and git state
pack_oci_layout() creates blobs/sha256/ directory and content-addresses all layers
inspect_layout() parses index.json, manifest, config, and verifies layer SHA-256 digests
unpack_template() verifies blob digest and safely extracts scaffold to destination directory

hidden: Unpack operation strictly enforces filter='data' on Python 3.12+ against path traversal attacks (src/ckodex_aiops/adapters/distribution/oci.py:315)
Unpack verifies blob SHA-256 matches manifest descriptor before extraction (src/ckodex_aiops/adapters/distribution/oci.py:307)

patterns.name: Pure Semantic Kernel Isolation
patterns.description: Pure domain logic and state algebra are isolated from all infrastructure, database, and cloud framework SDKs.

patterns.name: Evidence-Bearing Execution Receipts
patterns.description: Every state mutation or consequential execution emits an immutable, content-addressed LineageReceipt.

patterns.name: Memory-Safe Secret Value Redaction
patterns.description: Sensitive credentials are held in non-printing SecretValue containers that redact cleartext and support explicit wipe.

patterns.name: Autonomic Day-2 Reconciler Loop
patterns.description: Continuous convergence of observed technical state back to authoritative promoted baseline profiles.

patterns.name: Multi-Layer OCI Image Layout Packaging
patterns.description: Scaffold and compliance manifests are packaged as typed, content-addressed layers in OCI Image Layout v1.1.0 without daemons.

invariants.claim: kernel module imports zero adapter, transport, or third-party framework dependencies
validation module imports no adapters or pipelines
secret values in runtime secrets are never printed or converted to raw strings without redacting
mandatory anti-invariant violations dominate scores and cannot be averaged away
OCI template layout adheres to OCI Image Spec v1.1.0 with zero container daemon requirement
all repository source files satisfy ruff format and linting standards
invariants.check: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .

invariants.claim: Hugo living documentation compiles cleanly with zero errors and zero warnings

claimed.text: README.md:270 suggests physical AI robotics telemetry streaming is an integral pipeline in the platform.

actual.text: src/ckodex_aiops/pipeline_registry.py:32 omits physical_ai_pipeline from the default pipeline composition, requiring explicit --pipeline=physical_ai invocation.

do_not_touch.reason: Constitutional 7-dimension vector state algebra (S(e,t) = <P, V, A, C, E, L, tau>) and anti-dominance invariant enforcement. Modifying these rules compromises mathematical guarantees of non-averaging risk.
Memory-safe secret wrapper and redaction boundaries. Any accidental string interpolation or print leakage breaks zero-trust secret protection.
Cryptographic SHA-256 lineage receipt schema and digest computation. Modifying serialization breaks content-addressed provenance verification.
